mandatoryDesign.universeReceipt: survivorship-safe PIT universe with market/listing/delisting/session vintage
mandatoryDesign.pairSearchRule: fixed candidate-generation rule and exact search breadth
mandatoryDesign.twoLegTradability: both legs must be tradable at decision/execution clock
mandatoryDesign.borrowability: short-leg borrowability evidence; missing remains UNKNOWN
mandatoryDesign.costs: two-leg commissions/tax/slippage/impact/borrow cost with evidence quality
mandatoryDesign.overlap: pair overlap and repeated-symbol dependence preserved
mandatoryDesign.multipleTesting: entire searched pair/model/window family is the testing denominator, not only selected winners
